title: Tool Info
description: Standard output schema for the `info` subcommand of all Amadla tools and plugins. Every tool and plugin MUST output data conforming to this schema when invoked with `<binary> info`.

name.description: Binary name of the tool or plugin (e.g., 'raise', 'raise-libvirt', 'judge-application').

version.description: Semantic version of the tool or plugin (e.g., '1.0.0').

engine.description: Implementation engine or backend (e.g., 'libvirt', 'vault', 'podman'). Required for plugins, omitted by parent tools.

supports.description: Entity type URIs this tool or plugin handles (e.g., 'amadla.org/entity/infrastructure@^v1.0.0').

description.description: Short human-readable description of the tool or plugin.
